culprit_citations.quoted_text: FR Refuel, LLC | First Lien - Delayed Draw Term Loan | SOFR + 486 | 8.5 | 11/8/2028 | par dash | amortized cost - | fair value (9) | pct of net assets -

findings.detail: The pct_of_net_assets field was stored as -0.1 even though the source row's percent column is a dash; the negative value belongs to fair value only.

rationale: C404 is a Class 1 single-cell check on pct_of_net_assets. The flagged row is FR Refuel, LLC First Lien - Delayed Draw Term Loan. The raw SOI row shows fair value as (9) and the % of Net Assets cell as '-', not -0.1. The extracted negative percent is therefore not source-backed; it appears to be an extraction/normalization error from the neighboring negative fair value cell.
